p.bio: Originally from Rosario, Argentina, I hold a degree in Industrial Chemistry. My passion for sailing has led me to navigate in various classes of vessels, from J24 and Soto33 to GS32, IMS, Maxi, and classic boats. In 2019, I achieved victory in the Maxi World Championship in Sardinia. Likewise, in the Soto40 World Championships in 2012 and 2015, I secured impressive second and third positions, solidifying my reputation in international nautical competitions.
